findings_to_judge.finding: The Q4 FY2026 revenue guide of US$23-26m given on 2026-06-08 implies a year-over-year decline of -15.0% to -24.8%, two to three times the -7.5%/-7.8%/-9.1% printed in Q1/Q2/Q3, because Q4 FY2025 revenue was US$30.6m -- a figure the company has never reported and that only exists as FY2025 US$118.0m minus nine-month FY2025 US$87,390,942.

On 2026-08-12 the company said it will 'progressively optimize its third-party publishing business in casual titles, and in particular in the social casino category' and is now running its existing portfolio 'with user acquisition and operating expenditure allocated according to return on investment rather than scale' effective the current quarter -- and that release traded 22,679 shares, under 6% of the baseline's 408,260 twenty-day average, closing $0.79 to $0.74 to $0.70.

The baseline's +11.95% five-day run-up is almost entirely one session -- 2026-08-31, 7,314,944 shares (about 27% of the 27,038,542 non-affiliate shares the F-3 counts) and +16.51% to $0.85 -- reacting to a 6-K filed 2026-08-28 that merely extended a US$5m buyback of which only ~US$600,000 (518,063 shares) had been used in twelve months; the identical event a year earlier produced +103.54% on ~46m shares and fully retraced.

The FY2027 growth premise management gave on 2026-06-08 -- 'the user base to return to growth as multiple new titles launch through fiscal 2027', with one RPG live by end of Q2 calendar 2026, one 'launching around September' and one signed for an August-to-September launch -- has no visible trace: neither Apple developer account (GAMEHAUS PTE. LTD, 5 apps; GAMEHAUS LIMITED, 4 apps) lists a single RPG title, and the Aug 12 strategy release does not mention the RPG pipeline at all.

A dilution and entrenchment sequence executed in five weeks and never described anywhere as a sequence: Class B voting power raised from 15 to 50 votes per share by shareholder vote on 2026-07-10 (15,598,113 Class B shares, so ~95% of votes), a US$200,000,000 primary Form F-3 shelf filed 2026-07-28 stating a non-affiliate float of US$23,523,531.54, that shelf going EFFECT 2026-08-11/12 -- the same window as the AI narrative release -- and no 424B on file as of 2026-09-07, meaning the ~US$7.8m baby-shelf capacity (one third of float) is entirely unused and live.

Seven Section 16 initial statements (Form 3) were filed for Gamehaus insiders with event date 2026-03-18, including founder-level CTO/director/10% owner Yan Xi reporting 5,314,953 Class A shares through Joystick Holding Limited -- people who have been insiders since the January 2025 listing -- even though foreign private issuers are exempt from Section 16 and the company continued to file 6-Ks and a Form F-3 afterwards.

Neither of the two most material press releases of 2026 was ever furnished on Form 6-K: EDGAR full-text search returns zero hits for 'Third Quarter of Fiscal 2026' under CIK 0002000530 while the same search for 'Second Quarter of Fiscal 2026' returns two, so the last EDGAR-visible revenue datapoint for GMHS is US$26.3m for the December 2025 quarter and the June 8 Q3 release and August 12 strategy change exist only on the wires.
